scope: Isolated Chromium/WebCrypto/IndexedDB mechanism + fictional HTTP authority; NOT private app/Clerk/hosted/security proof

checks.name: Automatic non-extractable keys seal the 18-player read and 17-mark original without credentials or plaintext storage
Covered reads and page reopening use retained keys with zero key exchanges and no unlock prompt
An actual browser-process restart retains the encrypted original and reopens automatically; no authenticator
Aborted key provisioning acknowledges no active store or plaintext fallback and can retry without lost work
Aborted capture commits neither replica nor intent; an unsettled original cannot be replaced
Logout deletes replicas/read/cached-recovery keys but retains pending ciphertext; device key alone cannot recover it
Another authenticated account and even a wrong recovery key with forged correct labels cannot open retained work; original account recovers without restoring replicas
An incompatible device handle cannot open, activate or clean another namespace; its original remains intact
A key response begun before logout cannot reactivate its durable scope fence
Failed 30-day cleanup durably closes access across reload; retry removes read copies and preserves recoverable pending work
Known denial stops local opening and server key release; a different device is denied
Missing persisted device key refuses reopening/reenrollment and retains original ciphertext
Missing scope metadata cannot create an empty vault over orphaned keys/original ciphertext
Tampered authenticated ciphertext is refused without clearing the original
Competing storage connections commit one immutable pending capture without partial replica writes
Storage failure is explicit without a plaintext or falsely acknowledged fallback; this is injected failure, not real disk exhaustion

limitations: Fictional HTTP identity and in-memory key custody; no Clerk/current database/account proof
Same-origin scripts before cleanup can use cached keys; no hardware/OS-keystore guarantee
One read/pending research scope, not typed app repository/real register sync
No real quota exhaustion, browser eviction, key rotation recovery or schema migration proof
30-day cleanup invoked explicitly; trusted time/clock rollback integration remains
Page assets served before offline; no hosted cold-offline boot/service worker
No physical device/provider p75/p95 or Supabase/Redis cost measurement
Not an independent security audit; private app enablement remains closed
